fields.label: Default Signature Profile
fields.options:
B-B
B-T
B-LT
B-LTA
CCA-LTV
CCA-LTA
fields.description: Used when a Print Format leaves its profile blank. LTV/LTA profiles need Trust Anchor Directory; timestamped profiles need a TSA.

fields.label: Timestamp Authority
fields.description: A registry TSA; blank uses the Custom TSA URL below, if any

fields.label: Custom TSA URL
fields.description: RFC 3161 endpoint; used only when no registry TSA is picked

fields.label: Trust Anchor Directory
fields.description: Server path to a folder of CA certificates (the OpenSigner repo ships one under trust/). Needed for LTV profiles and for the verify page to report trusted signatures.

fields.label: Verification Base URL
fields.description: Base URL printed inside stamp QR codes; blank uses this site's URL

fields.label: PKCS#12 Key File (.p12/.pfx)
fields.description: Used by Server Key print formats and auto-sign. Stored as a private file.
